title: Myth flip — the bot that was kinder than her doctor
caption:
Myth: if AI sounds sure, it's right.
AI answers got rated kinder than doctors' (JAMA, 2023). It's also less accurate on bodies it rarely saw (PNAS, 2020). Use it for questions, not diagnoses.
Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #aihealth #healthmyths #patientadvocacy #askyourdoctor

phrases: The bot answered in warm, certain paragraphs.

scenes.text: Sounding sure and being right are two different things.
phrases: It read her worry better than anyone had.
It also learns from whoever it was shown most.
PNAS, 2020: medical AI got less accurate on the sex it saw least.

scenes.text: Tonight: ask the bot what to ask a human, then take three questions in.
phrases: Paste your symptoms. Ask it: 'What should I ask my doctor?'
Keep the three best questions in your notes app.
Ask your clinician to write the answers into your chart.
